text: Fresh complete null-guard patch read. cachedIdentity begins null and is assigned only when idKey is present and changes. The optional chain allows a missing identity to skip domain completion while preserving the truthy autocompleteToMyDomain condition. It does not conceal a required receiver or change the existing applicability, comma, explicit-address, domain-substitution and listener-result branches. The full selected current search/result implementation and unit fixture were read. Existing tests cover configured identity preference, empty input, explicit @ address, comma and excluded header families, but this fixture does not directly exercise the missing/null-identity branch. The historical local --verify nonreproduction and author TSAN before/after reports are attributed; a preceding 2022 fix was reopened as still happening. No runtime, TSAN, browser test or log link was executed/opened. Reviewer asked for optional chaining specifically where nullable access guards a truthy field; author applied it. This is a scoped accepted practice, not a mandate to use optional chaining for every object or evidence that this one patch resolved the entire intermittent family.
title: Optional chaining skips domain completion when the cached identity is absent
